description: a thicket-forming shrub with smooth gray bark

details: A tall shrub grows here, a dense clump of upright stems that has spread outward into a low thicket.  The bark is gray and mostly smooth, striped with darker vertical markings and beginning to fissure near the base of the oldest stems.

seasonDetails.winter: The reddish-brown twigs end in narrow, pointed buds sheathed in several overlapping scales.  Suckers crowd the ground around the clump, tangling its edges into a thicket.
seasonDetails.spring: The young leaves are oval to nearly round with blunt tips, coarsely toothed above the middle and smooth-edged below, and faintly downy beneath.  Short, crowded racemes of fragrant white flowers smother the stems, each bloom carrying five narrow petals.
seasonDetails.summer: The leaves are oval to nearly round, dull blue-green above and paler beneath, coarsely toothed along the upper half of each margin.
seasonDetails.fall: The leaves have turned to yellow, orange, and red.  They are oval to nearly round, coarsely toothed along the upper half of each margin.

keywords: saskatoon serviceberry juneberry shrub bush thicket smooth gray bark oval leaves rounded tips stems tree

Harvestable.preDescription: The stems are heavy with clusters of dark purple berries, each dusted with a pale waxy bloom.
Harvestable.postDescription: The shrub has been picked clean of berries.
